title: M_ST_TB_1 monitored report sample
purpose: Add a monitoring-direction timed measurement/report seed that differs materially from command traffic and reaches CP56Time2a-sized object parsing.
expected_behavior: The peer should parse the APDU as an I-format monitoring ASDU with TypeID 32 M_ST_TB_1, one object, spontaneous cause, common address 1, IOA 2, a one-octet step-position value with transient flag cleared, followed by a 7-octet CP56Time2a-sized timestamp payload.
constraints_preserved: TypeID 32 is preserved for M_ST_TB_1 from the supplied CP56Time2a monitoring catalog
Length octet 0x14 matches 4 control octets plus 16-byte ASDU
Single-object VSQ is used to keep object boundaries explicit for mutation
Monitoring report direction is separated from client command traffic
issue_safety_notes: This is a passive report-shaped seed for parser coverage; timestamp bytes are benign placeholder values chosen to preserve CP56Time2a-sized structure without reproducing any known issue payload.
